items.original_title: Gold Slumps on Rate Hike Outlook, AI Stocks Selloff
items.rss_summary: Gold slid below $3,500 an ounce as a selloff in stocks continued and a key inflation print reinforced bets on further Federal Reserve rate hikes. Bullion declined as much as 3.7% to $3,426.77 an ounce. A rout in gold has gathered pace recently, with the metal plunging nearly 9% last week, on track for a third straight monthly decline of more than 6%. Bloomberg's Mike McGlone joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Потоки нефти в Ормузском проливе «навсегда изменились», говорит Том Клоза
items.original_title: Oil Flows in Hormuz Strait 'Forever Altered,' Says Tom Kloza
items.rss_summary: Tom Kloza, chief energy advisor to Gulf Oil, said that he expects a 'major head fake' from the oil market as the 'seeds' for the next oil rally have been planted and could take gas and diesel prices back up in the beginning of 2027.  Kloza also discussed the continued impact that war with Iran has had on the oil market, and said that his view remains that oil flows in the Strait of Hormuz are 'forever altered' by the conflict. (Source: Bloomberg)

Iranian army spokesperson Mohammad Akrami-Nia said the country’s military is on heightened alert and warned vessels that they must coordinate transit with Iranian forces for safe passage, according to Iran’s Tasnim News...
